steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: *sniff* *sniff*

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I smell honey biscuits!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Yes, I just baked some.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wow!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: One for Vulcan, one for me! One for Matterhorn, one for me! One for Lava, one for me...

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Here's another batch of weapons that need repairs, Vulcan.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Go play by yourself for a while, Kay. I have some work to get to.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: We've taken care of the ones that just need honing or oiling, but there are a few that are above our pay grade.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Alright, I'll take a look at them.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: It's been disassembled. Everything's here: Originium circuit, crossbow frame, and other miscellaneous parts.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Regular maintenance and testing are complete; the hard part's with a modification.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: The user is a sniper, but he wants to add a built-in shield.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Like the round shield I designed? It only protects the user, but it's portable and can be carried on the belt.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The integrated Originium circuit can boost the user's Arts, or even be used as a weapon itself.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: But adding it to a crossbow adds dead weight while compromising integrity. That's why I was thinking about rejecting the application.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Don't worry, leave it to me.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The recently developed elastic parts, as well as the ultra-thin ones developed by Blemishine, may come in useful.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: We'll leave it to you then.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: There's a lot to do today...

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: We have a bunch of weapons coming in for repair and maintenance.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Looks like they went through the grinder out there.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Look at this crack. The user would've been severely injured without the shield there. See how many arrowheads got caught in it?

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Here's Operator Matterhorn's shield too.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Talk about a deep crack... was he trying to dig a tunnel with it?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Seems like it'll need to be replaced sooner rather than later.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll disassemble it. Check the integrity of the individual parts.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Oh, n-no, it's just that this is my first chance to work with you, so I'm a bit nervous...

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: The veterans of the Engineering Department talk about you a lot. I'll do my best!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Well, good luck.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll find some steel.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Hibiscus's staff, Fang's lance, Beagle's shield, Kroos's crossbow...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Their weapons have a tendency to take a beating.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: These are what they used when they first came to Rhodes Island. These are the ones that I've modified. Can you tell the difference?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Rhodes Island operators have to work in a variety of environments, which demands a high degree of versatility from their equipment.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's also important to take into account each operator's personality and individual needs. The craftsman's intentions must never supplant the user's needs.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Like the accessories that Kroos hangs here?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Many operators are very attached to their weapons, and we must be extremely attentive to this in our work.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The better we know the user, the better we can fulfill their requests.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Alright, this batch of weapons is done.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: May they serve their operators well.
Excuse me, Vulcan, are you there?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Yes, come in. The door's unlocked.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hello. I would like to commission a new shield.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: This is the one that I've been using. It's gone through a lot of repairs, and it's getting less and less effective in combat. It's time I replaced it.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: This one? I've worked on it many times.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yes, I brought it with me from Kjerag.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It was made with steel that could withstand the extremely low temperatures there.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Away from Kjerag, however, it no longer performs at the same level.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yes, you mentioned that before, but I didn't want to replace it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: With the crack from this latest operation, though, I can see that it's reached its limit.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: We ran into a pack of enraged needleflies, and their poisons have seeped into the crack.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's going to be difficult to clean out the poison and needlefly pieces in order to repair it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Even a layman like me can see how complicated it is.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: So... I guess this is the end of the road for this shield; there's no way to get it back to peak form.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Needlefly poisons, and pieces from their mouthparts... definitely a headache.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The size of the crack has also warped the structure in the back.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The internal cracks are visible to the naked eye... what on earth have you guys been doing?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: And this is after you were able to evade some blows, it looks like... Otherwise, the shield would have already shattered, by the looks of the bite marks.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: So what do you plan to do with it once you get a new one?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Retired equipment is typically sent to storage, either to be used in training or dismantled into parts that can be reused.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Those with special significance are stored separately, or returned to their owners.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: This shield was forged by the smiths of House Silverash, passed down to me from my grandfather to my father, both bodyguards to the family.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's a symbol of our vow to give our lives in battle, a vow I took when I received it from my father.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's also a symbol of my duty to protect Lady Ensia, as commanded by my lord.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That's why I really appreciate the efforts you've put towards repairing it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But I fear there's been too much damage this time.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Perhaps it would be better to clean it up and keep it for remembrance, while we craft a new shield for battle.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Making a new one is easy. We have the materials, the knowhow, and I have experience fixing your shield.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: But I want to ask you a question.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If it could be fixed, and not just as good as new, but even better, would you rather have it as a keepsake, or continue to use it?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Stop worrying about the how.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You came here and told me the story behind it, what it means to you.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I can tell you care a lot about it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Caring won't fix a broken shield.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You haven't even asked if I could fix it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...That's impossible.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I never said that.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Think it over. About what to give up on, and what to keep. Then you make your decision.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That's what a lot of operators do when they come to me.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Let's talk, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I spoke to a girl by the name of Rockrock. Do you know her? She's from Victoria, and she's only been here at HQ a few times, but she left a deep impression on me.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: No... Why do you bring her up?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: She's an interesting girl. A little like myself.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: She was born in an old industrial district, and she feels strongly about everything there. She made everything on her herself.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: She liked my machines, but she insists on only using things she's made with her own hands.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Like how you light the furnace and beat iron into ingots every day?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Is there any point to it? Not really.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The machines here can create ingots faster than I can. Rockrock understands that what she makes isn't necessarily better than what's available on the market.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But you both insist on doing it anyway...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Yes, because there's meaning behind it. It's part of my roots as a blacksmith.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Rockrock insists on using what she made herself because, even though she doesn't reject the new, she feels that her roots are still in that old industrial district.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: As for you, no matter how comfortable you are at Rhodes Island, part of you will always be on the snow-covered mountains of Kjerag. You'll always remember the teachings of your father and grandfather.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'm asking you, not as a blacksmith but as a friend, to let me continue repairing the shield.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Leave it to me. I'm sure you will be happy with the result.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Vulcan wasn't at the meeting just now, was she? I was working with her a few days ago, but I haven't seen her in the workshop lately.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: She's looking for a new type of metal to repair Matterhorn's shield.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: His shield?

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: But wasn't it heavily corroded by poison? I couldn't get that stuff off, no matter how hard I tried.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: I thought he'd give up on it?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Yes, but I had a chat with him, and apparently Vulcan told him she could fix it.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Seriously?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: You're new here, so you probably don't know that it used to be just her repairing everyone's weapons before we got more people in the department.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: I even heard that she once forged a legendary weapon, which shook heaven and earth when it left the forge!

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: It made all of Rhodes Island tremble... possibly a little exaggerated, of course, but she definitely lives up to her code name.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Oh, how I want to bear witness to her work...

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Is she in the workshop? Can I go watch after I finish my work?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Nope, she went out to hunt for ore after assigning my duties.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: She's probably digging around in a cave somewhere.

steps.name: Villager's Voice
steps.text: Careful, girl! A big monster lives in that hole. No one dares get close to it.

steps.name: Villager's Voice
steps.text: Trust me, plenty of folks have come looking for gold or treasure, but very few have returned.

steps.name: Villager's Voice
steps.text: And with a leg like that! You're walking into a death trap.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Just keep your distance, sir.

steps.name: Villager's Voice
steps.text: *sigh* Young folks these days.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Here. Not far from the projected position.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Environment and scale are within projections.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The terrain may present some difficulties, but the bait and sedative are ready.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Kjerag steel is forged in a way that makes it stronger in a cold environment. It will take the perfect replacement to repair it.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: A few years ago, I found a small piece of crystal on an Originium slug. It had absorbed the slug's secretions, making it extremely strong.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The well is about 300m deep. My gear checks out.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: ...I think I got something!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Good, they're all out cold.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Don't worry, this won't hurt... all I need is some of these crystals...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Oh no, there's another nest in back!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Completed deposit and strength testing under different temperatures.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Layering looks like it can work well. Layering steel with materials that have high tensile strength helps keep the weapon together during impact.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I need to think about quenching time and temperature, however.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I tried a partial quenching a couple of days ago, and the metal shattered.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: More precise temperature control is required.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll need to remove this shelf to make room in the workshop.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Columbia really does make fine machines.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: ...Let's start.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Highlight composition ratios, oxygen levels...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Setting temperature and time based on this...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Adjust the angle... increase temperature... initialize...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Alright, that's close to maximum!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: There we go!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: *cough* A new forging method—

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Test successful.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Vulcan? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Good morning, Instructor Dobermann.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Can I use the training facilities to test this shield?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Should I grab a trainee or two to help you out? Practicing with a veteran will do them some good.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Even better, thanks.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Ready, Instructor!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That's not enough. Don't hold anything back. Throw everything you have at the shield.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Don't worry about injuring me.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Instructor...?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Do it. Vulcan is a lot stronger than you are, and she's forged this shield using a new method.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Can I ask you to give it a try yourself, Instructor Dobermann?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Ready!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Nice shield!

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: C-Closure! Excuse me...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Did... did Vulcan really make a weapon that made Rhodes Island tremble?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Who told you that?
Two weeks later...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Whew—

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: All done.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: And right on schedule.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: There's time for one more round of tests before the deadline.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Excuse me, Vulcan, are you there?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Come in, please.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I've fixed your shield.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sorry, Vulcan, I didn't think you would actually pull it off...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Try it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It... it really is my shield!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You really made it good as new!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Yes. I used a new forging method, and found a mineral with the right tensile strength to supplement the steel.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's not quite as cold-resistant as the original, but the layered structure allows it to maintain adequate strength even in extreme conditions.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's every bit as strong as it was. I didn't do anything with the shape, but I've added some Originium circuits in the back. They're automatically triggered and don't require the user to be skilled with Arts.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Don't test it here, though; do it with the equipment at the training grounds.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I never thought... I didn't think it was possible, but you...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: In just two weeks?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Two weeks was plenty.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I didn't know... When you went on a field trip a few days ago, I thought it was going to get delayed...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Thank you so much, Vulcan.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: This is my job, after all.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I do this to help operators fix their weapons, meet their needs, and allow the equipment to perform at its best.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Each person's armament means something different to its owner.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: As a craftsman, I strive to deliver the best results.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That's all.
